## DAS-based upper bound

**b = 0.9849 (DAS relative-magnitude Aki MLE), Sigma = −2.698, P(M≥5.5)/yr = 0.0784** (P over observed volume = 2.41e-03).

This is the **upper bound**, not calibrated: DAS magnitudes are relative/uncalibrated, and every detection is counted as an event at or above the catalogue Mc, so it **over-counts** — ~0.078/yr versus the calibrated 1.2e-04 to 1.5e-02/yr.

**Bottom line:** the calibrated catalogue-based estimate of a Pohang-like Mw ≥ 5.5 event at Brady Hot Springs in March 2016 is very low (≈10⁻⁴ per year at b = 1, up to ≈1.5×10⁻² per year at b = 0.65); the DAS-only number (≈7.8×10⁻²/yr) is an uncalibrated upper bound that over-counts and should not be read as a calibrated probability.
